model_interpretation.claim: Hoisting row bases and applying a compile-gated OpenMP SIMD hint to the contiguous-x loop may help the compiler vectorize the radius-3 update when its OpenMP support is available. The ordinary loop remains as a fallback; no target ISA, row alignment, or fixed vector width is assumed. Measure both core budgets, including setup costs, and validate the fixed tolerance before drawing conclusions.
model_interpretation.transformations: {"files":["src/candidate.cpp"],"retained":["Hoisted each z/y row base and used row pointers for the x-contiguous stencil accesses.","Added an OpenMP SIMD directive for the x loop only when _OPENMP indicates OpenMP 4.0 or newer; left the loop unaligned and with a generic scalar fallback."]}

model_interpretation.claim: A persistent OpenMP team should avoid repeatedly creating a team across six dependent timesteps. Static worksharing over disjoint (z,y) rows keeps x contiguous; each worksharing loop's implicit barrier ensures the next timestep sees completed output. This trades fork/join overhead for six synchronization points and tests one implementation against the serial baseline; it does not establish a comparison with a per-step-team implementation before controller measurement.
model_interpretation.transformations: {"files":["src/candidate.cpp"],"retained":["Replace the serial six-step sweep with one OpenMP team whose lifetime spans all timesteps.","Use static collapse(2) worksharing across interior z/y rows while retaining contiguous x traversal.","Rely on the implicit worksharing barrier between steps to preserve timestep dependencies and buffer parity."]}

items.subject: Combiner SIMD sur x et parallélisme OpenMP par lignes
items.objective: Demander un candidat mesuré combinant le noyau à bases de lignes et directive SIMD OpenMP de T2 avec la parallélisation OpenMP persistante et le partitionnement par lignes de T1. Partir du candidat T2 le plus rapide; éviter le parallélisme imbriqué, conserver les barrières entre pas, respecter threads et toutes les contraintes de correction. Comparer aux deux sources aux budgets d’un et quatre cœurs; ne pas présumer que les gains s’additionnent.
